rawContent: Yes, blame the women for not walking out the show which they have earned participation in. But don't blame the harasser, his enablers. Whatever a man does, the blame shall always be on a woman. 👌 #MeToo

The #BiggBoss team might think they owe no answer to public for platforming a #MeToo accused. But questions won't stop. The brilliant @MoharBasu and @chandana_hiran ask, "When a man hasn't even apologised, how do we even think about rehabilitation?"
https://t.co/BDRBlcFoIR

"Does @ColorsTV think its audience endorses alleged sexual abusers? What else could be the reason of them onboarding having a man, accused by at least 10 men of sexual harassment?"

"Another #MeToo accused, Vikas Bahl, is back to work. We've failed all the women, who spoke up."
